experiments.name: switch
experiments.hypothesis: A three-case switch for the signed 0x40..0x42 range should restore the retail unconditional branch removed by nested-if simplification.

experiments.name: reuse25
experiments.hypothesis: Reuse the no-longer-needed actor handle local for the event-3 allocation, testing whether MWCC coalesces it into retail r25.

experiments.name: register
experiments.hypothesis: Test standard C register hints on the shared long-lived r30/r28 locals, rather than separating transient return values as attempt 5 did.

experiments.name: nested
experiments.hypothesis: Restore a single nested argument expression for the ED/3A calls; MWCC right-to-left argument evaluation may allocate expression temporaries differently from statement-level SSA values.

experiments.name: fallback
experiments.hypothesis: Place the common unhandled-event fallback after the final state branch, with a distinct else return for an unknown state, matching retail two zero-return blocks.

experiments.name: maskphi
experiments.hypothesis: The event-3 mask and later mode have disjoint lifetimes; using the same short local tests coalescing priority against the allocated event handle.

experiments.name: declorder
experiments.hypothesis: Test MWCC allocation tie-breaking by declaring the event handle before its short mode and after the long-lived locals.

experiments.name: calleeprototype
experiments.hypothesis: Use the independently reconstructed callee prototype: u16,u8,u8,float,vector,s8,u8,u8,u16,u32. Its float is the fourth C parameter; PPC keeps the same ABI registers but expression scheduling can differ.

experiments.name: constfloat
experiments.hypothesis: The retail float is a small-data constant; const qualification may let scheduling move its load across outgoing argument setup.

experiments.name: eventpointer
experiments.hypothesis: Use the callee-backed pointer return type for fn_801A717C and pointer parameters for its consumers; test pointer versus integer allocation/coalescing without changing the ABI.

experiments.name: statechain
experiments.hypothesis: Express mutually exclusive state handlers as an else-if chain; test whether MWCC region nesting changes interference-graph traversal while preserving comparison order.

experiments.name: earlymode
experiments.hypothesis: Initialize the short mode before the event allocation. This tests whether earlier live-range construction favors retail r26 while scheduling sinks the constant initialization.

experiments.name: intmode
experiments.hypothesis: The logical mode only takes zero and one; test an int local with explicit call-site narrowing to see whether the short local artificially changes interference and register allocation.

experiments.name: voidsetters
experiments.hypothesis: Correct event setters to their independently reconstructed void return types and u16/u32 parameters, testing whether discarded artificial integer results influence allocation.

experiments.name: argumentmask
experiments.hypothesis: Reuse the dead incoming object argument for the event-3 integer mask, testing MWCC parameter live-range coalescing separately from ordinary local reuse.

experiments.name: scopedevent
experiments.hypothesis: Give the event-3 allocation its own pointer local instead of sharing the animation result variable from event 0x25, testing cross-branch live-range coalescing.

experiments.name: knownmode
experiments.hypothesis: Inside the event==3 branch, express the mode as event-2. Test path-sensitive constant propagation and whether retaining the event live through allocation changes mode/event register selection.

experiments.name: final
experiments.hypothesis: Preserve the best semantically faithful source: switch range, nested accessor calls, corrected fallback, const float, callee-backed declarations, and dead parameter reuse. Remove unused decompiler locals.

reproduction: Run from eternal-darkness-decomp. Restore src/game/game_fn_8006330C.c from base_commit bdd16be340554b66efc12987d07eaf45fb03e2a3, apply the chosen patch_from_base with patch -p0, and run the recorded commands in order. Each patch independently starts from that base. Final source is experiment final. No additional C translation units are retained.

findings: switch restored the exact two-bound signed case-range branch sequence.
Nested accessor calls preserve the observed right-to-left order under the canonical compiler and fix both ED/3A register allocation regions.
The common unhandled-event fallback belongs after the state chain, distinct from the unknown-state else return.
lbl_8064E648 is .sdata2 float data in config/GEDE01/symbols.txt; const qualification restores exact argument load scheduling.
Parameter reuse fixes the event-3 mask register. Other named-local reuse, register hints, declaration order and narrowing experiments do not resolve event-handle/short-mode coloring.
Callee-backed pointer/void declarations and the fn_801AAE68 fourth-position float prototype were preserved for accurate type intent; they did not independently improve the score.
